title: TchoAI - The AI workspace for presentations
excerpt: Upload a document, paste your notes, or start from a prompt. TchoAI writes the slides, builds the charts, and exports to PDF or PPTX.
content_html:
Bring the work. Leave with the presentation

Editable slides and charts, built from your documents and data. Ready to present in minutes.

Works with PDF, Word, Excel and plain notes.

Early bird pricing

Choose your plan

Discounted rates for our early access users.

  • Create up to 20 slides per generation

Pro

Recommended

Maximize your productivity

Everything in Plus, and:

  • Create up to 50 slides per generation

Frequently asked questions

What documents can I upload?

PDF, Word, Excel, CSV, Markdown, plain text and images, up to five files of 20 MB each. Or skip the files and just describe the deck you need.

Can it connect to my data and products?

Stripe and PostHog connect today with a read-only key, so revenue and product figures land in your slides without a copy-paste. Google Analytics is on the way.

How do credits work?

Credits are how we measure usage of AI features. The number of credits used depends on the amount of slides generated.

Can I still edit the slides myself?

Yes. Ask for a change in plain language, or edit text, charts, themes and backgrounds directly. Nothing is locked behind the generator.

In what formats can I export?

PDF and PPTX. The PowerPoint export stays editable, so you can finish a deck in the tool your team already uses.

Still unsure? Ask us anything.

Your next deck is already half-written

Upload what you already have and see your first deck before you decide anything.

常见问题

What documents can I upload?

PDF、Word、Excel、CSV、Markdown、纯文本和图像，最多五个文件，每个文件大小为 20 MB。 或者跳过文件并仅描述您需要的套牌。

Can it connect to my data and products?

Stripe 和 PostHog 现在通过只读密钥进行连接，因此收入和产品数据无需复制粘贴即可显示在您的幻灯片中。 谷歌分析即将推出。

How do credits work?

积分是我们衡量人工智能功能使用情况的方式。 使用的积分数量取决于生成的幻灯片数量。

Can I still edit the slides myself?

是的。 要求更改通俗语言，或直接编辑文本、图表、主题和背景。 发电机后面没有任何东西被锁定。

In what formats can I export?

PDF 和 PPTX。 PowerPoint 导出保持可编辑状态，因此您可以使用团队已使用的工具完成幻灯片。

还不确定吗？ 有什么问题都可以问我们。
